package: LGA-8 metal lid 3.0 x 3.0 mm, 0.8 mm pitch
kicad_symbol: Sensor:BME680 (pins 1 GND, 2 CSB, 3 SDI, 4 SCK, 5 SDO, 6 VDDIO, 7 GND, 8 VDD: CONFIRMED identical to BME690 table 26 p52)
kicad_footprint: Package_LGA:Bosch_LGA-8_3x3mm_P0.8mm_ClockwisePinNumbering (clockwise numbering in top view matches p52; land pattern p54: 0.6 x 0.4 pads [check against the footprint])

supplies.VDD: 1.71-3.6 V, ripple <= 50 mVpp; optimised for 1.8 V (p7 note 1)
supplies.I_peak_mA: 17 typ / 18 max (first ms of heater on)

logic: Interface pins limited to VDDIO + 0.3 V (p15). Run at 1.8 V: sits on the 1.8 V I2C segment behind the PCA9306 with the AS7341 and LSM6DSV16X. (At VDDIO = 3.3 V it would also work on I2C_S directly; 1.8 V is chosen because the heater and ASIC are optimised for it.)

i2c_addr.select: SDO: GND 0x76, VDDIO 0x77; must not float (p46)

placement: Shared gas vent; vent hole in the lid needs air exchange, about 1 m/s air-flow for the stated response time (p12).

Its hot plate reaches 320 C (p8): keep it a few mm from the SHT40/STCC4 so it does not bias their temperature, and away from the SGP41's air path. Do not place both MOX parts (BME690, MiCS-5524) right next to each other.
Minimum solder height 50 um after reflow (p56); no board wash over the vent [mem: Bosch handling note].
notes: Chosen over the BME688 (3,913 in stock, $11.50): the 690 is in stock above 300, cheaper and lower power in ULP/LP modes (p3).
Duplicates pressure, humidity and temperature already measured by the BMP581 and SHT40; it is here for the gas scan (BSEC library, closed binary).
